name: k8s-generatename
notes: Run with: python3 evicon_review.py measure k3s (release 068). The fault proxy on VM-C terminates TLS (throwaway certificate) and re-opens TLS to the API server, so faults act on the HTTP request and reply, not on the handshake. Identity = generateName prefix: the server names every object, so a retry creates another (measured locally: K0, duplicates).
fault_model: network loss/delay, client abandon; owner up (no owner crash or reboot)
